Lead 2026-10-04 (S7.1 review REVISE):
F1: the by-design vs no-match classification moves to the library. eyes4s serves an unmatched-focal finding with a reason (NoReferenceInDesign | ReferenceNotAdmitted(refs, disposition)), computed against the pre-admission TrialInventory and the pairing key, plus the byDesignQueries count. An optional declared expected-unmatched selection (e.g. an old/new column) prevents a lure being paired through an id collision. The protocol then serves Eligibility.ByDesign, and studio only maps codes to wording. Remove categorize, InventoryReference, UnmatchedReading, QueryCategory and PresetError from studio-core. The library part rides with lane-analysis's p0-unmatched work (owner decision on no-match eligibility).
F2: PerceptionImagery needs a document schema rung after S5.7's v4, i.e. v5, with a test.
F3 (and S3.7 slice 2 Q1): presets declare the match layout. Inventory datasets use TrialKeyDefinitions.trialLayout; the story/preset recipe and the fixture are corrected. The real backend refuses a layout that does not match the dataset's key type with a typed recipe/plan mismatch.
F4: a preset choice is one composite undoable command.
